product_summary: Website (eskayengichem.com, About Us + homepage) states: established Oct 2005 as corporate entity of Eskay Industries; MIDC Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune. Originally manufactured bulk drugs Metformin Hydrochloride and Buformin Hydrochloride under Maharashtra FDA licence; since 2010 focus shifted to drug intermediates and fine/speciality chemicals, explicitly named: Crown Ethers, 2-Propoxybenzoic Acid, and 'other high-value chemical intermediates'. Site markets itself as 'Manufacturers of Drug-intermediates and Speciality Chemicals', ISO 9001:2015 (TUV Nord), claims supply to leading Indian pharma companies and exports to Asia, Europe, Japan, USA. The on-site compound catalogue is JavaScript-driven and returned 'No compounds found' on fetch, so the full product list (names/CAS) could not be read - only the three product families named in the About Us text are verifiable.
role_hint: manufacturer (own MIDC plant, own FDA Maharashtra bulk-drug licence history, ISO 9001:2015) - no trader signs found on site
comment: HS 294190 covers 'other' antibiotics (e.g. cephalosporins/penicillins-type actives) - a narrow pharma-API heading. Nothing on the company's own site supports antibiotic manufacture: the declared line is not corroborated by any product named by the company. Actual product line is fine/speciality chemicals and non-antibiotic drug intermediates: biguanide bulk drugs (Metformin/Buformin HCl -> 2925.29), 2-propoxybenzoic acid (-> 2922.29/2918.99), crown ethers (-> 2932.99), plus residual 2942.00 for other drug intermediates. Per Rule 3 the company is NOT rejected: HS mismatch only, code to be corrected to the factual line (primary candidate 2925.29 / 2932.99 / 2942.00 as applicable per shipment). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a partial misclassification - the company is pharma intermediates / fine chemicals, not oil & gas. Trader signs: none observed. Product lines missing from the declaration: crown ethers (phase-transfer catalysts, also used in electronics/electrochemistry), 2-propoxybenzoic acid, and the legacy biguanide bulk drugs. All product claims are from the company's own website only - no customs line was available to me, therefore every HS mapping above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (declared, not confirmed); the catalogue page could not be read (JS-rendered, empty result), so the product list may be incomplete. No registry, revenue or shipment data researched per role scope.
